en.badr-shahin: 4. Mohammed bin Ali Majilwayh, May Allah have mercy upon him, narrated to us from his uncle Mohammed bin Abi al-Qasim from Mohammed bin Ali al-Kufi from Mohammed bin Sinan from al-Mufaddhal bin Umar that
Imam as-Sadiq (a) said: "He who claims being one of our Shia while adhering to the rope of others has lied."
